changelog: Adds two explicit channel experiences while preserving the established UI and scheduling model. Personalized TV now waits 1.5 seconds after confirmed Loading playback, resolves Resume before never-started content for Next Unwatched and Random Unwatched, and opens VOD at 00:00 before issuing one guarded post-progress seek for Resume or wall-clock offsets to avoid webOS non-zero-start freezes. Standard TV is a separate true linear Live TV pipeline with only concrete schedules, no Loading/VOD handoff, no seek/restart/resume/Next Up, no Jellyfin watched-state impact, wall-clock-aligned programme entry, continuous H.264/AAC MPEG-TS output, and automatic English subtitle burn-in when a supported English track is available. Existing channels remain Personalized TV by default. Guide spacing, Content Coverage, Smart Schedule, visibility and single-item VOD queue protection are retained.
description: Virtual linear TV channels generated from media already available in Jellyfin.
